_doctrine: The pre-registered condition catalog -- the SINGLE home for each condition's identity (display_name), umbrella->subtype structure (umbrella_of), and Wallach's synonym phrasings. Promoted 2026-07-05 (Phase B) from the emergent derived index + eden/tools/{condition-taxonomy,condition-synonyms}.json + corpus_derive DISPLAY_OVERRIDES (all retired). A claim may reference a condition slug ONLY if it appears here (references_resolve gate) -- closing the phantom-slug hole where a typo silently minted a condition. Hand-edited pillar: register a NEW condition here BEFORE mining a claim that maps to it. User is sole writer once sealed. SYNONYM MATCHING is OCR-folded, punctuation-insensitive, all-words-present; significant words of display_name + slug tokens are accepted implicitly, so list only DIFFERENT wordings. UMBRELLA_OF children must be real condition slugs (child->parent only; naming 'cancer' does NOT name 'leukemia'). display_name for the search-only slugs absent from the operational index is humanize(slug).
